technique_name: Evaluate the effectiveness of a local charity program.
description: To evaluate the effectiveness of a local charity program, it is important to consider three main factors: goals, implementation, and outcomes. Goals are the intended objectives of the program - what the program hopes to achieve. Implementation is the process by which the program is put into action - what strategies are used and how successful they are.
